facts.claim: The cross-industry app retention average is 25% at day 1, 8% at day 7 and 4% at day 30
facts.source_title: Mobile App Retention Benchmarks by Industry
facts.excerpt: The industry average in 2026 is 25% on Day-1, 8% on Day-7, and 4% at Day-30.

facts.claim: Fintech apps retain a median 28% at day 1, 12% at day 7 and 7% at day 30, with strong performers at 35-45%, 18-25% and 10-15%
facts.source_title: App Retention Benchmarks: How Your App Stacks Up by Industry
facts.excerpt: Fintech apps: strong performers 35-45% Day-1, 18-25% Day-7, 10-15% Day-30; medians 28%, 12% and 7%.

facts.claim: Only 5% to 7% of apps still retain users at day 30
facts.excerpt: Only 5-7% of apps retain users by day 30, with most apps losing nearly all users within a month.

facts.claim: North America leads day-35 download-to-paid conversion at a 2.6% median, nearly twice India and South-East Asia at 1.4%
facts.excerpt: North America leads D35 conversion at 2.6% median, nearly 2x IN/SEA's 1.4%.

facts.claim: AI apps earn 41% more revenue per payer and churn about 30% faster
facts.excerpt: AI-powered apps generate 41% more revenue per payer, but they churn 30% faster.

facts.claim: More than 120 million UPI Autopay mandates are created every month in India
facts.source_title: UPI Autopay vs Card e-Mandates: 2026 Decision Guide
facts.excerpt: Over 120 million UPI Autopay mandates are created every month in India, supporting SIPs, OTT subscriptions and insurance renewals.
